dict.string: Cladiron reads your steps, workouts, heart rate, and — for recovery-aware coaching — your heart-rate variability, resting heart rate, sleep, and body weight, so your activity, Watch-recorded sessions, and readiness appear here. Cladiron stores this health data on your device and never sends it to a Cladiron server.
Cladiron saves summaries of your workouts (strength, cardio, intervals, and swim) to Apple Health so they appear system-wide and close your Activity rings.
Cladiron connects to a Bluetooth chest strap to record accurate heart rate during workouts.
Cladiron uses your location to map and measure outdoor runs and rides recorded on your iPhone.
Cladiron keeps recording your outdoor route while your iPhone is locked or in your pocket during a workout. It stops when the workout ends and never tracks you at other times.
